A.title: Reset your security token
A.markdown:
# Reset your security token
## Overview
Use this guide if your security token has expired or was compromised.
## Steps
1. Go to **Settings** → **Global Reset**.
2. Choose *Confirm reset*.
## Troubleshooting
If the option is missing, contact support.

B.title: Download an invoice
B.markdown:
# Download an invoice
## Overview
Use this guide to download a copy of any past invoice.
## Steps
1. Go to **Billing** → **Invoices** → **Download**.
2. Choose *PDF format*.
## Troubleshooting
If no invoices appear, check your billing period filter.

C.title: Enable email notifications
C.markdown:
# Enable email notifications
## Overview
Use this guide to turn on email alerts for account activity.
## Steps
1. Go to **Settings** → **Notifications** → **Email**.
2. Choose *Enable*.
## Troubleshooting
Check your spam folder if emails don't arrive.

D.title: Update your profile photo
D.markdown:
# Update your profile photo
## Overview
Use this guide to change the photo shown on your profile.
## Steps
1. Go to **Profile** → **Edit** → **Photo**.
2. Choose *Upload new image*.
## Troubleshooting
Images must be under 5MB.
